sandbox.title: Light the campus core
sandbox.problem: Many campus streets between hostels, colleges and the library are dark after sunset, which makes walking back from labs and the library unsafe.
sandbox.objectives: Bring the streets of the campus core up to IS 1944 lighting levels (8 lux on campus streets, 15 lux on main roads) with even light and no dark gaps.
sandbox.sustainability: LED lights use about half the power of the sodium lamps they replace; solar units on a quarter of the poles keep part of the network lit during power cuts.
sandbox.summary: LED street lights every 30 m on the streets within 600 m of the library, a quarter of them solar.
sandbox.implementation:
1. Night survey with a lux meter along the chosen streets to record today's levels and the poles that already exist (map them as existing).
2. Fix spacing and pole positions on site; avoid gates and tree crowns.
3. Install poles and LED fittings street by street, with timers or dusk sensors.
4. Measure again and compare with the plan.
